nodes.description: External view function getBalances(address[] users, Token[] tokens) that iterates over nested loops and returns an array of token balances.
Input parameter 'users', an array of addresses supplied by the caller.
Input parameter 'tokens', an array of Token contract addresses supplied by the caller.
Local variable numUsers = users.length, used as loop bound and multiplication operand.
Local variable numTokens = tokens.length, used as loop bound and multiplication operand.
Dynamically sized uint[] memory array 'result' populated with balances and returned.
Local index counter resultInd, incremented inside the inner loop to write into result.
Outer loop index variable userInd iterating over users.
Inner loop index variable tokenInd iterating over tokens.
Unchecked multiplication 'numUsers * numTokens' used as the array allocation size; Solidity 0.4.23 has no overflow protection, so large array lengths can wrap to a small allocation size.
External call tokens[tokenInd].balanceOf(users[userInd]) to a caller-supplied Token contract inside a loop; callee code is untrusted and may reenter or consume gas unpredictably.

edges.reason: users.length is read from the caller-supplied array and assigned to local numUsers.
tokens.length is read from the caller-supplied array and assigned to local numTokens.
numUsers is an operand of the unchecked multiplication numUsers * numTokens, which can overflow.
numTokens is an operand of the unchecked multiplication numUsers * numTokens, which can overflow.
The possibly wrapped multiplication result determines the size of the allocated result array.
The balance returned by the external balanceOf call is stored into result[resultInd].
The caller-supplied tokens array selects which external contract is invoked in balanceOf.
The caller-supplied users array supplies the address argument passed to the external balanceOf call.
Inner loop index tokenInd drives the increment of resultInd, controlling the write index of result.
Outer loop index userInd determines the loop bound and hence the control flow of getBalances.
Inner loop index tokenInd determines the nested loop control flow of getBalances.
resultInd tracks the write position of the array that the function ultimately returns.
The array produced and filled inside the loops is returned by getBalances.
External caller-supplied array users flows into the public entry point getBalances.
External caller-supplied array tokens flows into the public entry point getBalances.

normalization_plan.reason: The users parameter is only meaningful as input to getBalances and can be folded into the function signature.
The tokens parameter is only meaningful as input to getBalances and can be folded into the function signature.
numUsers exists only to feed the unchecked multiplication that sizes the result array.
numTokens exists only to feed the unchecked multiplication that sizes the result array.
result is the temporary buffer whose contents are immediately returned by getBalances.
resultInd is a purely internal loop write index with no independent semantic meaning.
userInd is a purely internal outer loop counter of getBalances.
tokenInd is a purely internal inner loop counter of getBalances.
